It also shows potential environmental, dermal, and eye hazards based on expanded scientific data beyond GHS (Tier 2). However, significant data deficiencies (Tier 4) exist for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, endocrine disruption, and inhalation hazards, indicating unknown risks in these areas.
